children.value: > Fact From Story A new class action lawsuit filed this week in the U.S. District Court in D.C. accuses Google and parent company Alphabet of anticompetitive behavior in violation of U.S. antitrust law, the Sherman Act, and others, on behalf of news publishers.

> > Fact From Story The case, filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle, argues that Google “siphons off” news publishers’ content, their readers and ad revenue through anticompetitive means.
> > > Fact From Story The case argues that Google is "starving the free press".
> > > Fact From Story The case was filed by Arkansas-based publisher Helena World Chronicle.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A publisher is a company or organization that produces and distributes newspapers, magazines, books, or other printed or electronic material.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Siphoning is taking something from something else.
> Commonsense Knowledge Accusations are claims that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
